messages:
Sam: Hey sec folks — putting together a short, copy-pasteable request template for gated SIEM exports and retained log slices. Can someone sanity-check this for RBAC/KMS constraints and oncall handoff?
Liz: Love this. Please call out the minimum retention window and justification field.
Maria: Also add a field for 'data minimization steps' — which fields are removed or hashed before export.
Joe: For KMS: note whether the requester needs key-unwrap permission or if we provide a wrapped token. We should prefer wrapped tokens handed to oncall only.
audit-bot: Note: exports containing principal identifiers require 30d justification in the ticket per policy SEC-LOG-07.
Sam: Draft template below. Trying to keep it short so SRE/oncall can approve quickly. Thoughts?
```
EXPORT REQUEST TEMPLATE
- Requester: (name + team)
- Purpose / customer-impact: (why, expected urgency)
- Data scope (streams, time window): (e.g., api-requests-prod, 2026-03-10 00:00 -> 2026-03-12 12:00)
- Fields requested (explicit list)
- Minimization steps (scrub/hash PII, drop headers, sampled)
- Retention requested (ttl) and justification (business/legal)
- KMS handling: (unwrap required? wrapped token provided?)
- Access window: (start/end)
- Approving oncall: (name)
- Delivery mechanism: (secure bucket, SFTP, SIEM remote ingest)
```
Liz: Looks good. Suggest adding 'fallback model' — what we do if key unwrap fails or the oncall is unreachable.
Maria: Also require "least-privilege consumer account" — a service account name that will receive the export.
Joe: Operational note: prefer short-lived presigned URLs + client-side encryption for delivery. If using wrapped keys, include key id and envelope algorithm.
Sam: Q: For a sensitive export (contains usernames/IPs), what should the default retention be? 7d? 30d?
Liz: Default policy: 7d for troubleshooting-only slices; 30d only with legal/customer justification. Put that in the template as the checkbox options.
Maria: What about RBAC approvals? Do we need manager + security approval for >7d?
Joe: Yes — >7d requires security sign-off. Changes to service-account entitlements should go through ACL PR with a ticket link.
Sam: Good — I'll update template. Any KMS rotation/unwrap play concerns?
Maria: Make sure to require ephemeral unwrap tokens generated by key-proxy with a one-hour TTL. Document command to request one in KB.
Joe: Example CLI snippet to request wrapped token from key-proxy: `key-proxy request --key-id projects/infra/keys/siem-export --ttl 1h`
Sam: Final ask: can one of you add the QA checklist for oncall approving exports? Short checklist like "confirm minimization, confirm key handling, confirm delivery destination secure, note retention + create deletion ticket".
Liz: I'll add a 4-item checklist in the KB and link it from the template.
Maria: I'll draft the ACL PR template for granting the consumer service account, include reviewer tags for infra and security.
Joe: If nobody objects, I'll add a paragraph to the oncall runbook describing emergency unwrap escalation (pager rotation and contact).
Sam: Perfect. I'll push the updated template to the KB and open a follow-up thread with the link. Thanks all :thumbsup:
__note: This thread is intentionally concise and operational — captures RFC-style Slack coordination for a gated SIEM export request template, RBAC/KMS handling, retention defaults, and oncall checklist.
